title: Review round 3: burnOnRead focus + R2 fix verification
description: Targeted round 3 review focusing on the burnOnRead/receiptSharing interaction (corrected twice). Also verify R2 fixes for Receiver Behavior redundancy, deviceDeliveredAt explanation, and federation Peer/deliver burnOnRead note.
notes: R3 Calibration (SEC7): Reviewed 8 open findings under jmap-chat-spec-wrl. Count: P0=0, P1=0, P2=0. All 8 findings are priority 3-4 (elegance/readability/opinion). No protocol-correctness bugs found. wrl.27 (deviceDeliveredAt no top-level parallel) is already fixed in the spec (explanation present at deliveryReceipts line 519). The burnOnRead/receiptSharing causal ordering is correctly specified: receiver sets readAt locally and hard-deletes even when receiptSharing=false; sender gets no Peer/receipt confirmation and must not rely on it. The bidirectional suppression rule (Sender Behavior: suppress outbound; Receiver Behavior: suppress inbound delivery to clients) is coherent and complete. Remaining open issues are editorial quality-of-life improvements only. Confidence: 90%. DONE: yes
